The '''Jundland Chasm''', known as the '''Desert Wound Ravine''' to some locals,<ref name="TOR:Oasis" /> was a canyon that ran through the rock formations that divided the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] and the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TOR:NC" /><ref name="TOR:CC" /><ref name="TOR:SC" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] maintained [[Outpost Salara]] at the eastern end of the chasm.<ref name="TOR:DD" />
